_docs.purpose: Which ward each short street named in a headline lies in, and whether it is clear of a ward boundary. Written by scraper/ward_postcode_evidence.py from postcodes.io (ONS data); read by ward_decision in scraper/editorial_contract.py.
_docs.single_ward: true only when every postcode within 250 metres of the street's postcode is in the same ward. A street near a boundary is recorded but never used to tag a story.
_docs.do_not_edit: Entries are looked up, not typed. Delete an entry to have it looked up again.
